resources.string: Start Bluetooth starts the selected sensor emulator. On the reader phone, use Find another emulator to discover its address; the reader does not need its own emulator running. Start NFC on the Proxmark host, then scan it with the reader.

NFC must contain the address of the selected sensor emulator. Use Find another emulator on the reader phone, then Report address to host, or enter that result here on the NFC host. Finding the reader from this phone gives the opposite address. Discover Bluetooth address asks a Wear companion; a paired companion may return a saved identity and is rejected. Refresh discovery if Android changes the address.
